title: Prawn and Tomato Baked Risotto
ingredients: 1 unwaxed lemon, zested then cut into wedges
150g (5.5oz) fine asparagus spears, woody ends trimmed
parsley leaves, finely chopped, to serve
method: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan (425°F), Gas Mark 7.
Spray an oven dish with low-calorie cooking spray and add the tomatoes, onion and garlic. Mix and spray again. Place into the oven and cook for 20 minutes.

Remove the dish from the oven, stir in the lemon zest and prawns, season with salt and pepper, then stir in the rice. Pour the hot stock over, then carefully return the dish to the oven. Bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven, stir with a fork, then place the asparagus on top, season and spray with low-calorie cooking spray. Return to the oven for a final 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and finely chopped parsley.
notes: Make this vegetarian by replacing the prawns with 2 roasted and chopped red peppers and substituting the chicken stock for vegetable stock.
